newsitem.title: ITALY: Six die in Italian motorway crash.
newsitem.headline: Six die in Italian motorway crash.

text.p: Six people died and four were seriously injured in a crash on the Rome-Naples motorway on Thursday, a police spokesman said.

Four cars were involved in the smash near the town of Caianello and traffic was blocked for nine km (six miles) along the southbound carriage way as emergency services tried to cut the bodies from the wreckage.
The victims' names were not immediately released.
